meta.method: STL decomposition, robust z-scores on the remainder
meta.note: Flags are statistical, not explanatory. Coinciding movements in other series are corroboration only and are never presented as causes.

series.label: All items (headline)
caveats: Anomalies are months where the STL remainder exceeds 3.5 robust standard deviations (median absolute deviation). This is a statistical flag, not an explanation.
Coinciding movements in other series are shown as corroboration only; they are not evidence of cause.
